name: toasttab-mcp
description: Toast (toasttab.com) for Claude — find restaurants that order through Toast near a point, resolve ordering links, and read their online or full register menus, with a read-only GraphQL explorer. Relays every request through the ContextMint Bridge browser extension (github.com/nullnet-app/contextmint-bridge) in your own browser, so Toast's Cloudflare check is passed by you, not bypassed.

ws_port.title: Bridge WebSocket port
ws_port.description: Optional. Overrides the fetchproxy WebSocket port (default 37149, the fleet-shared port). Leave blank for the default.

fetchproxy_ws_host.title: Bridge bind interface (hosted only)
fetchproxy_ws_host.description: Optional. Bridge bind interface, a literal IP only (anything else is ignored); default 127.0.0.1. Keep on loopback — it exists for a hosted child in its own network namespace. Leave blank for the default.

fetchproxy_identity_dir.title: Bridge identity directory (hosted only)
fetchproxy_identity_dir.description: Optional. Where to store the long-term bridge identity keypair, an absolute path only (anything else is ignored); default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/. Exists for a host that runs a separate child per caller. Leave blank for the default.

tools.name: toast_find_restaurants
tools.description: Find restaurants that order through Toast near a latitude/longitude.

tools.name: toast_resolve_restaurant
tools.description: Turn a Toast link, shortUrl or GUID into the restaurant GUID.

tools.name: toast_get_menu
tools.description: Read a Toast restaurant's online or register menu, with search.

tools.name: toast_list_orders
tools.description: List your Toast order history (needs a toast.app sign-in).

tools.name: toast_get_order
tools.description: Read one past Toast order as a receipt (needs a toast.app sign-in).

tools.name: toast_get_loyalty
tools.description: Read your Toast restaurant loyalty programs (needs a toast.app sign-in).

tools.name: toast_get_wallet
tools.description: Read your Toast Cash balance and units (needs a toast.app sign-in).

tools.name: toast_graphql
tools.description: Run a read-only GraphQL query against Toast's ordering gateway.

tools.name: toast_healthcheck
tools.description: Check the browser bridge and Toast gateway end to end.
